## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Brighton, United Kingdom. It starts at Marine Parade, Sussex.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take a deep breath and dive into the journey of a lifetime at SEA LIFE Brighton. Set amongst original Victorian architecture from 1872, you'll meet a cast full of gliding rays, twirling tentacles and glittering fins, including the UK's biggest collection of sharks and rays.
>
> Play games that let you decipher hidden messages. Collect nasty rubbish from the ocean and learn about conservation. The Day & Night exhibit lets you experience the 24-hour spectacle of a coral reef and other oceanic wonders in both daytime, and nocturnal environments.
>
> You can also touch a starfish or an anemone – and watch a fish feeding frenzy! Don't leave Brighton without wading into this watery wonderland. The kids will love it, and learn something, too.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €27.42. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 112 ratings and 49 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
